verdict.rationale: The only SDK-related evidence is Stripe's llms.txt, which tells readers to check the npm registry when installing "Stripe packages". That implies official client packages exist, but it does not document an Issuing-specific SDK, supported languages or coverage. The API reference pages, CLI and MCP server are adjacent capabilities and do not count as SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and their supported languages, confirmation that the SDKs cover Issuing resources (cards, cardholders, authorizations), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
